purpose: P2b event-stream fixture for the dsh-native Zig adapter: drive the real harness with a scripted provider and interaction, then compare the normalized v4 session log.

sourceArtifacts.reason: No committed snapshot records a mode switch while a turn is open; the live dsh recording dispatches /plan off from inside the first model call so the queue is committed by the next in-turn pre-step.

openIssues: dsh logs agent/inbox/spliced bookkeeping and runtime-context user messages; the adapter's v4 log omits them (P2a fixture convention).

The adapter appends a system/message per step; dsh replaces the changed prompt node in place (packages/plan/plan-mode/tests/integration.spec.ts:130-180). Compaction can select a mid-conversation system node.
The adapter fires the mid-turn command deterministically from the first provider call; dsh logs it when the user submits it, which can fall anywhere in the step.
